subject: Number of threshold parameters exceed the number of ordinal categories in GRM model in R

messages.author: 5ddfe566330663b8
messages.subject: Number of threshold parameters exceed the number of ordinal categories in GRM model in R
parts:
I am relatively a novice both in IRT modeling and R.  I am coming across a puzzling situation.  I am trying to conduct a GRM model on Likert-type data that have 5 response categories, so I should have 4 threshold parameters in my results.  With this data set, the results are displaying between six and ten threshold parameters.  Does anyone have an idea why this could be happening?  Thanks in advance.
Rob
